record.question: When arbitral award is received by the Engineer-in-Charge, and the award is within the delegated power of the Chief Engineer, he shall process it and send it within 15 days to the Chief Engineer for his decision on whether to accept or challenge the award. The Chief Engineer shall make decision within:
options: 10 days after receipt of case from EE
15 days after receipt of case from EE
20 days after receipt of case from EE
25 days after receipt of case from EE
record.explanation: The Chief Engineer decides within 15 days.
